alter_sql: CREATE TABLE o_pt (id bigint, d date NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (d,id)) PARTITION BY RANGE (d); CREATE TABLE o_pt_26 PARTITION OF o_pt FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01'); CREATE FUNCTION o_pt_f() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER o_pt_ai AFTER INSERT ON o_pt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION o_pt_f();
